dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It is rather pleasant here, far away from all the commotion. We needn't be in a hurry to leave.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I would offer to paint your portrait since we have some time on our hands, but unfortunately I don't have my new palette on hand.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm... I suppose I could peruse one of the books here. Reading is a fine way to calm the mind.
